events.title: The Demo Is Available Now!
events.summary: A tiny colony has found its way into the kitchen—and it is ready to grow.Experience a relaxing incremental game about building momentum, discovering new possibilities, and watching your colony become more efficient with every step forward.Play the demo, share your feedback, and add the full game to your wishlist!
